title: Routes and travel
summary: The story opens routes to other regions. Travel overland from the Command Core.
text:
Your landing site is one region of a whole planet. Zoom out (or press 2) to see the globe, carved into regions.

As the story goes on, it opens **routes** to other regions (the log says "New route"). To go, select the **Command Core**: its **TRAVEL** list shows every route on this world. Tap one, then tap again to be sure. The game saves where you are and takes you there.

- A region you haven't been to is a **new expedition**
- A region you've played before is just as you left it
- Routes to other worlds need a Launch Gantry: the Core's list says how many are waiting

Missions set in another region show its name under GOALS until you go there.
